title: After 6 years of designing games, I’m finally making my own. It’s called We Need a Bigger Ship.
author: Weird-Hamster9328
selftext:
I’ve been designing games for the last six years, and with the help of AI, I’m finally able to build a full game of my own.

It’s called **We Need a Bigger Ship**, and it combines a few genres I enjoy. You build your ship by arranging weapons and support modules on a grid, and there are different modes to use that build in.

One mode is similar to Backpack Battles, but with a sci-fi spaceship theme. You put together your build and fight against other players’ saved ships.

The other combines tower defense, inventory management, and twin-stick shooting. You build up your defenses between rounds, then control your pilot during fights against waves of enemies and bosses.

I wanted to share it here and hear what people think. If it sounds like something you’d enjoy, you can [wishlist it on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5551460/). It would mean a lot.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Weird-Hamster9328 please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. A mention that AI was involved isn't enough. It needs dev details. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Please see the requirements for posts about commercial games promotion.

**Game Promotion Posts Allowed, with Requirements**

You must discuss your game within the context of how it was developed using AI. Share with the community and give something for the community to talk about in your development experience with AI. A fire and forget video/image with no text, chatGPT bullet list may be removed by mods. If your game is being sold, you MUST apply the "Commercial Self Promotion" flair.
